label: Extra
text: Economist Shtero Nozharov (as published: Щерьо Ножаров) told NOVA News on 30 Oct that the government's own plan-smetka books a 7.3% deficit for 2027 without measures, so the real fight is over the structural deficit and the accrual-basis figure — whether it stays at 5% or falls to the 4.3% the government claims, which Brussels will only accept as durable structural measures.
